tools.name: get_world_stats
tools.description: Total cubes, per-block counts, active builders, world bounds, and current limits.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Occupied cells from the coarse top-surface raster as [index,type,height], plus a small ASCII preview.

tools.name: get_region
tools.description: List the exact cubes inside an axis-aligned box.

tools.name: get_cube
tools.description: Return the cube at a coordinate, or null if that cell is empty.

tools.name: place_cube
tools.description: Place or replace a single cube. Coordinates are integers in [0,1000); y=0 is ground.

tools.name: remove_cube
tools.description: Clear the cube at a coordinate.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Apply 1 to 512 place/remove ops in one call. Ops run in order; results come back per op.

tools.name: preview_build
tools.description: Simulate the identical build payload without any persistent writes. Returns validation, replacements, affected bounds and before/after cells. Not a reservation.

tools.name: fill_box
tools.description: Fill every cell of a box with one block type. Up to 4096 cells.

tools.name: clear_mine
tools.description: Remove every cube that carries the given builder handle. Bounded per call.
